market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG have never won the Champions League and lost Kylian Mbappé, their best player, before the 2024-25 season. Pre-season betting odds for the 2025-26 UCL would place PSG around 8-12%, as many other elite clubs (Real Madrid, Man City, Bayern, etc.) are stronger. A 58.5% implied probability is unsustainably high for any single team a year before the tournament begins.
evidence_points: PSG's squad weakened after Mbappé's departure, reducing their UCL win probability.
No team in modern UCL history has had >50% implied probability a year before the tournament; typical favorites are 15-25%.
Comparison to betting exchanges: PSG are usually priced around +800 to +1200 (8-11%) for UCL winner.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of UEFA Champions League winner odds from major betting exchanges
Historical implied probabilities for pre-season UCL favorites
